verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a broad REST API, a sandbox, an llms.txt, CalVer versioning and a single legacy webhook OpenAPI spec, but none of it mentions any official client SDK or library. The main API has no public OpenAPI spec from which SDKs could be generated. SDKs are a fair axis for a payments API platform, so the lack of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
